usedFor: Shopify raises store events, and ManyContacts receives tags on contacts through “Add Contact Tag”.

bestTemplate.name: “Abandoned Checkout” in Shopify, then “Add Contact Tag” in ManyContacts
bestTemplate.why: A tag marks who left a checkout, so you can find them in ManyContacts later.

watchOut: “Add Contact Tag” in ManyContacts needs a contact to tag, and “Abandoned Checkout” in Shopify is polling.
